//: What: npm manifest of the Fiori app as a UI5 project: UI5 tooling (@ui5/cli) builds a preload bundle and ui5-task-zipper packs it with xs-app.json into dist/procurement.zip for the HTML5 Application Repository.
Why: [CAP-M22] / [CAP-STAGE-10] in production the UI is not served by the CAP server but from the HTML5 repository; the mta.yaml html5 module runs npm ci && npm run build here (cds add html5-repo).
If missing or unlinked: mbt build fails for the html5 module and the app deployer has no procurement.zip to upload.
name: procurement
